Open Food Network offers tech solutions to support a better food system.

This is our original tech tool, an open source ecommerce platform where you can start your shop for free.

We are a non-profit, so we take a small admin fee ONLY when you make more than $500 a month.

Whether you’re a Community Food Enterprise, farmer or producer we can support you to sell food direct to community, to buyers and consumers.

Highlights

Merrifood Hub

Visit shop

Merrifood Hub is a community food enterprise and was set up by two locals in the northern Melbourne suburbs. They have an in-person market every week where locals can come to a community space to pick up their orders made on Open Food Network or buy then and there.

Charmaine and Sarah, the founders, source small food producers, prioritising growers and suppliers who are local and who use environmentally-sustainable practices.

Open Food Network creates a free ordering system for the founders, where they can track orders, predict community needs and produce demand.

Merrifood Hub is one of Open Food Network’s partners on the Good Food For All project. Where a tech platform was built to funnel funding into food vouchers that could be printed and distributed to the local community to use at Merrifood hub markets.

Are you a regenerative producer?

We work with The Regenerative Food and Farming Alliance, philanthropists and government bodies to change the food system to work for the small scale farmers who are on the ground changing the way we manage land for the better.

Discover Regenerative is a directory for regenerative farmers which links direct to your OFN shop.

Here we tell your stories to policy makers, use satellite data to show the impact of your regenerative agriculture practices across Australia and bring visibility to the community of farmers doing the hard work.
